_comment: Names in 02/03/05 that 07 (revised) or 06 spell differently, applied by scripts/gen-data.js. "talents" also renames the base of "Base (Specialisation)"; "skills" fixes misspelt 06 skill names. Each entry's reason is in _sources.

_sources.Read/Write: Brief section 2; 07 (revised) line 5: Datapad Use 'replaces any other form of literacy'
_sources.Datapad Literate: 07 (revised) line 5 (same literacy note); Datapad Literate is not a talent in 07 (revised)
_sources.Animal Affinity: Brief section 2 (Creature Affinity); 07 (revised) random table uses Creature Affinity
_sources.Regenerate: Earlier 02 spelled Trandoshan's talent "Regenerate (Minor)"; 07 (revised) has Regeneration (Minor). 02 (revised) now uses Regeneration.
_sources.Briberyry: 05 (revised) misspells Bribery as "Briberyry" (a doubled conversion); 06 has Bribery.
_sources.Briberyr: 05 (revised) writes "Briberyr" in nine careers: the Bribe -> Bribery conversion also hit the talent Briber. 07 (revised) line 124 has Briber.
